parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of steel, forming the main structural component that holds the internal mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the spring and staple track, ensuring proper alignment and pressure during stapling.
parts.Movement_description: It moves downward when pressed to drive staples through paper and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler is made of durable plastic and covers the top portion of the stapler.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main contact surface for the user to press down, transferring force to the internal mechanism to drive staples.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge at the rear, moving downward when pressed and upward when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler is made of steel and forms the bottom support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable platform for the stapler, holds the anvil plate that bends the staple legs, and ensures proper alignment during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, providing resistance and stability while the upper parts move.
